slides.title: BMS and Acidity Research
slides.concept: A personal presentation by Denis Ethier on uncovering the chemical drivers of burning mouth pain.

bullets.text: My burning symptoms started 4 years ago.
Two things that helped:
Eliminating food
Dental work
I've been pain-free from burning for 8 months.

slides.title: Disclaimer
slides.concept: Important legal and medical context before sharing personal experiences and observations.

bullets.text: There's not enough research, so I did my own.
I am not a doctor, and this is not medical advice.
Always consult your doctor or dentist regarding your health.
Every mouth is unique, and this approach might not work for everyone.
This is a work in progress. This research is ongoing and comes solely from my personal experience.

slides.title: What I Tried Before Realizing Acid Was an Issue
slides.concept: Documenting the exhaustive search across medical consultations and conventional remedies.

bullets.text: Consulted 5 dentists and 5 doctors who all said everything was completely normal.
Prescription medication didn't work.
Tested over 50 vitamins, mineral supplements, and specialized oral rinses.
I didn't know what else to do.

slides.title: My Discovery on Acid
slides.concept: The foundational realization after years of negative exams that oral pain is driven by physical chemical inputs.

bullets.text: Category 1: Eliminated Alcohol
Category 2: Eliminated Coffee
Category 3: Eliminated Fruits and Condiments
Category 4: Eliminated Vegetables (Carnivore)
I've been pain-free on the carnivore diet.

slides.title: My 14-Day Carnivore Test
slides.concept: Looking back at personal history to trace how physical triggers were identified.

bullets.text: I found some videos about the carnivore diet.
I had never heard of it before and it sounded crazy, but I was willing to try anything.
Learned that many doctors actually discuss and recommend it for inflammatory issues.
Within weeks of trying it, the burning pain completely went away.

slides.title: Why the Pain Went Away
slides.concept: How underlying dental hardware and vulnerable entry points allow acid to provoke nerve pain.

bullets.text: It is very often a multi-cause.
Cavities and hidden decay under restorations create open pathways for acid.
Gum recessions expose sensitive dentin tubules directly to liquids and food.
Misaligned bite points create excessive focal pressure and micro-strain.

slides.title: Finding the Root Cause with Dentists
slides.concept: How targeted dental procedures lowered flare intensity and shifted pain locations.

bullets.text: Targeted dental procedures significantly lowered the intensity of flares.
The lower arch pain completely went away after removing tooth 36 decay.
In the upper arch, the burning pain left the back teeth and tongue completely.
The remaining sensation is now localized specifically around the canines.

slides.title: Other Triggers: Cumulative Pain
slides.concept: Understanding how secondary factors like stress and mechanical habits stack.

bullets.text: Referred pain and cumulative nerve stacking across the trigeminal network.
Psychological and physical stress amplify baseline sensitivity.
Subtle clenching, tongue friction, and bite pressure add continuous strain.
Multiple sub-threshold inputs stack until they trigger noticeable burning.

slides.title: The Realization: Why Cutting Some Acid Isn't Enough
slides.concept: Understanding why partial elimination fails to deliver lasting zero pain.

bullets.text: Eliminating beer or coffee gave temporary 6-month windows of partial relief.
Remaining dietary acids (fruits, vinegar, sauces) kept baseline inflammation simmering below the surface.
The bucket analogy: as long as acid inputs exceed nerve-firing threshold, the brainstem remains sensitized.
Realization: to achieve lasting remission, oral acid must be driven completely below the nerve activation threshold.

slides.title: Step 1: Remove Acids as Much as Possible
slides.concept: The actionable step-by-step testing roadmap for sufferers to prove cause and effect.

bullets.text: Step 1: Remove acids as much as possible.
Step 2: Notice after a few days or a few weeks if you see a difference.
Step 3: Notice what happens to the pain if you cheat on your diet.

slides.title: From Worrying to Peace
slides.concept: The transition from fearful anxiety to calm, permanent remission.

bullets.text: Last 7 months completely pain-free, with only one minor 1/10 flare recorded.
No more fear, no more panic about flares: complete understanding of physical cause and effect.
Moving from helpless patient to empowered lead investigator of your own health.
Proof that systematic recovery and peace of mind are completely achievable.

slides.title: Acceptance
slides.concept: Reframing pain not as a curse, but as the body's protective alarm system.

bullets.text: I wish I could still eat and drink whatever I enjoyed before without consequence.
Acid is inherently destructive to teeth and enamel over time.
Our mouths have dedicated pain receptors specifically to detect acid.
The pain was a clear biological alarm that what I was consuming was destroying my teeth.
